prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent walk-cycle sprite atlas for a small realistic human character in a bright professional website's 3D hall. Reference image: the supplied portrait establishes this adult man's identity: short tousled dark brown hair, brown eyes, fair skin, short neat beard, slim average build, pale blue fine-striped button-down shirt with open collar. Preserve his recognisable facial features. Create ONE square 1536x1536 transparent PNG sprite atlas with EXACTLY 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, no borders. Each of the SIX equal 512x768 cells contains this SAME man full length, head to shoes, at identical scale and camera distance, feet aligned at 94 percent of cell height, centred horizontally, head around 5 percent. He wears the same pale blue shirt, dark navy tailored trousers and simple brown leather shoes. Top row: rear three-quarter view, his head very slightly turned so a small natural portion of his profile is visible; three successive subtle natural walking poses: feet passing, left foot forward, right foot forward. Bottom row: matching front three-quarter view of the SAME man, with the same three successive walking poses, face clearly resembling the reference. Real photographic skin, fabric and hair textures, natural human anatomy, balanced proportions, ordinary understated professional clothing. Soft neutral daylight matching a bright white contemporary indoor hall. Crisp natural cutout edges. Genuinely transparent empty space everywhere outside each body. No floor, no cast shadow outside the feet, no background, no checkerboard, no props, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermarks, no extra people. Keep all limbs and shoes inside their own cell without overlap into neighbouring cells. This is a production sprite atlas, not a collage or a scene.
